teaser: A chipped coffee mug sits by the laptop at two in the morning, the screen still open to a tab nobody else would understand. You are a life path 11, reached by addition, laid over an INTP, and the two do not pull in a straight line. The 11 asks for a kind of knowing that arrives whole, inspiration without footnotes. The INTP wants the footnotes first. Put the two in one person and the cursor blinks on a draft that keeps almost explaining itself, caught between what it already senses and what it has not yet proven. That gap is the particular thing here.
